system.description:
You always gain [Cancel (Poison):20][Weakness (Radiance):10]. You gain +3D to [Undying][Poison] tagged damage rolls you make. A crown said to be used when burying noble individuals. It grants protection from powers related to darkness, poison, and death. As a consequence, it grants low resistance against holy power.
